findings.issue: `isIntegrallyClosedIn_plusSubring` is about 55 lines. Its `hx₀` block proves a standalone fact inline: under `[IsTateRing (uniformTilt p B)]`, `powerBoundedSubring (uniformTilt p B) ≤ plusSubring p h₀`.

findings.evidence: Diff lines: `rw [← hqb, ← hpq, Polynomial.eval₂_map]` followed by `rfl`.
findings.fix: Close the goal with an explicit statement `(S.map f).subtype.comp g = f.comp S.subtype` (by `RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl`) and rewrite with it, or add a comment naming the defeq being used.
findings.issue: `heval` ends `rw [...Polynomial.eval₂_map]; rfl`. The bare `rfl` depends on `f.comp S.subtype` and `(S.map f).subtype.comp g` being definitionally equal (by unfolding `RingHom.restrict`), and there is no comment saying so.

summary: The central integral-closedness proof hides two reusable facts inline (one of them already repeated three times) and runs past 50 lines. The quotient-descent lemma closes a rewrite chain with an undocumented `rfl` that relies on definitional equality of ring-hom compositions.
